sites.downstream: simple_classify(X) returns response.content[0].text.strip(); no repository callers or observable envelope diagnostics
sites.reason: Ten enumerated insurance categories, short text, no arithmetic or generation. Arbitrary public adversarial tickets lack a proven mitigation.

options.benefit: Accepted decisions avoid generative inference; expected cost = Jev cost + fallback fraction * original cost. Likely lower accepted-path latency; misses add serial latency.
options.risk: Confident misclassification, overlapping categories, injection on hostile tickets; provisional 0.90 threshold and original fallback retained.
